column1: # Custom partition table for 8MB flash with OTA support (Inkplate 5V2 / ESP32 classic)
# - Dual OTA partitions (3 MB each) for safe firmware updates
# - SPIFFS/LittleFS storage for assets and configs
# - Offsets (except nvs/otadata) must be aligned to 0x10000 (64KB)
# - The FQBN option `PartitionScheme=ota_3mb_8MB` must match this filename (without .csv)
